System of Social and Demographic Statistics 0000010107, item G6230; original source Japanese Red Cross Society; fiscal year. Counts donations, not individual donors. Counts of individual donors exist as a separate series in Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare committee documents (not obtained).
Donations divided by the population aged 15-69. Not the proportion of residents who donated; it also rises when the same people donate more often.

notes: Approximation to the mean during the fiscal year; for comparison only.

description: population aged 15-69 on 1 October of calendar year t
notes: Approximates the donation-eligible ages. The minimum donation age is 16, but the smallest 5-year band is 15-19, so no apportioning was applied.
For FY2005-FY2006 there is no 85+ band, so the 80+ band is used.
Baseline: geometric mean of FY2005-FY2009. dln_D = dln_P + dln_s + dln_r holds exactly.
Change in the share aged 15-69. Changes in age composition within ages 15-69 are not captured here and fall into dln_r.
Change in donations per resident aged 15-69, not in the proportion who donate; more frequent donation and more donors cannot be separated.
